title: Open-adjunction normalization of proper/open interchange on strict coefficient towers
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] such that every $P_n=A/I^n$ is finite. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
U&\xrightarrow{k}&V\\
r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\
W&\xrightarrow{i}&Z
\end{array}$$
be a commutative square of Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings) [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], meaning $pk=ir$, with $r,p$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $i,k$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]; cartesianness is not assumed. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and constant $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every corner $T$ put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$ [def-weil-inverse-system], and use its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], equivalently the ringed diagram-site derived category of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Write $G_u=u^{-1}$ termwise for inverse image and $R_u^{\mathcal T}$ for the total derived termwise direct image, with the canonical adjunction $G_u\dashv R_u^{\mathcal T}$. For an open immersion $j$, write $J_j$ for termwise extension by zero: sheafify the presheaf which takes an object factoring through the open to the given module's sections there, and takes any other object to zero, with the corresponding restriction maps. Sheafification means the left adjoint to inclusion of sheaves [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. This defines an exact functor on module diagrams and hence on their derived categories; its canonical adjunction is $J_j\dashv G_j$, with unit the identity identification $G_jJ_j\cong1$.

There is a canonical natural open-restriction isomorphism
$$\lambda_Q:G_iR_p^{\mathcal T}J_k\xrightarrow{\sim}R_r^{\mathcal T},$$
obtained by restricting $p$ to $V_W=V\times_Z W$, then factoring $k$ through its open-and-closed image $U\to V_W$, and using extension by zero on that open-and-closed component. The induced map $U\to V_W$ is an open-and-closed immersion. Fibre products are [def-pc-fibre-product]. Its direct-image comparison uses K-injective diagram resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]; its restriction to a Cartesian square is the inverse-image/direct-image square mate for base change by $i$, followed by the open unit identification. In the general commutative case it uses the same open restriction and the direct-image composition for the open-and-closed component. Define $\Gamma_Q:J_iR_r^{\mathcal T}\to R_p^{\mathcal T}J_k$ as the adjunct under $J_i\dashv G_i$ of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$, so
$$\lambda_Q\circ G_i\Gamma_Q=1_{R_r^{\mathcal T}}$$
under the open unit identification. This specifies an actual morphism in the derived diagram category, not a family of levelwise arrows.

Let $N\in D(\mathcal T_U)$ and suppose that for each $n$ its evaluation has a specified isomorphism
$$N_n\simeq\operatorname{Res}_{\underline A\to\underline{P_n}}\nu_U^*L_n,\qquad L_n\in D^+(U_{\mathrm{et}},P_n),$$
where $\nu_U$ is the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], the isomorphism is an etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and restriction of scalars is termwise [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. No transitions between the $L_n$ are assumed; $N$ already carries its strict transitions. Then $\Gamma_{Q,N}$ is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal T_Z)$. Evaluating it at $n$ and using the canonical direct-image and scalar-restriction comparisons gives the restriction of the pro-etale transport of the specified finite proper/open comparison of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], with direction $i_!Rr_*\to Rp_*k_!$. This statement fixes the comparison by its open adjunction and asserts its finite evaluation normalization; no faithfulness of evaluation functors on derived morphisms is asserted.
